mapper.sql: a.achievement_id, a.teacher_user_id, a.organization_code, a.evaluation_year, a.management_item_code, a.achievement_date, a.achievement_status, d.special_lecture_start_date, d.special_lecture_end_date, d.mock_exam_question_period, a.attachment_ref
FROM education_achievements a JOIN employment_rate_improvement_achievement_details d ON d.achievement_id = a.achievement_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE a.achievement_id = #{id} AND a.achievement_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_IMPROVEMENT' AND a.deleted_yn = 'N' FOR UPDATE OF a, d

SELECT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN m.effective_start_date AND COALESCE(m.effective_end_date, DATE '9999-12-31') ORDER BY m.effective_start_date DESC, m.mapping_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: WHERE s.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND s.item_code = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_IMPROVEMENT' AND s.active_yn = 'Y' AND s.teacher_editable_yn = 'Y' AND s.teacher_editable_part = 'SELF_REPORT' AND s.evaluation_confirmed_yn = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.organization_code = s.target_scope AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AND s.evaluation_year = #{year}
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT s.management_item_code FROM evaluation_element_management_item_settings s
ORDER BY s.management_item_code
SELECT u.user_id FROM users u WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{body.managementItemCode}, achievement_date = #{body.achievementDate}, attachment_ref = #{body.attachmentRef}, updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, request_id = #{trace} WHERE achievement_id = #{id} AND achievement_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_IMPROVEMENT' AND deleted_yn = 'N' AND achievement_status IN ('DRAFT', 'DEPARTMENT_REJECTED', 'CERTIFICATION_REJECTED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO education_achievement_status_histories ( achievement_type, achievement_id, previous_status, next_status, action_type, processed_by, request_id ) VALUES ('EMPLOYMENT_RATE_IMPROVEMENT', #{id}, NULL, 'DRAFT', 'CREATE', #{actor}, #{trace})
